output.question: What does Walmart's supply chain look like?
output.answer: As of 2026-11-11, Walmart describes a global, multi-channel supply chain linking U.S. and international suppliers to stores, clubs, eCommerce fulfillment centers and customers. Its FY2026 Form 10-K reports 192 U.S. distribution facilities and 179 facilities outside the U.S.; transportation combines Walmart's private truck fleet with common carriers, while some merchandise ships directly from suppliers to stores and clubs. The network also uses stores and clubs for online fulfillment and delivery, alongside direct shipping from eCommerce fulfillment centers and other distribution facilities. Walmart says its newer operating layer uses predictive warehouse and transportation-management systems, unified enterprise inventory, self-healing inventory rebalancing, warehouse automation monitoring and agentic AI to forecast demand, reroute inventory and optimize fulfillment.

key_facts.fact: Walmart's global supply chain includes U.S. and international suppliers, and it sometimes sources merchandise from producers near the stores and clubs where it will be sold, particularly perishables.
Walmart reported 192 strategically located distribution facilities in the U.S. and 179 outside the U.S. across Africa, Canada, Central America, Chile, China, India and Mexico.
U.S. transportation uses Walmart's private truck fleet together with contracted common carriers; Walmart began combining Sam's Club U.S. supply-chain operations with Walmart U.S. during fiscal 2026.
Most store and club merchandise purchases in fiscal 2026 moved through Walmart's distribution facilities, while most remaining merchandise was shipped directly from suppliers to stores and clubs.
For eCommerce, Walmart fulfills and delivers orders from stores and clubs and also ships directly from eCommerce fulfillment centers and other distribution facilities.

Walmart's described technology stack includes predictive warehouse and transportation-management systems, an intelligent orchestration layer for warehouse controls, self-healing inventory, enterprise inventory and agentic AI tools.
Walmart's supplier requirements cover standards of conduct, audits/certifications/testing, supply-chain security and packaging specifications designed for movement through distribution centers.
More than 1,000 Associate to Driver graduates had transitioned into Walmart Private Fleet roles as of January 2026, according to Walmart's FY2026 ESG report.

passages.quote: We utilize a global supply chain that includes both U.S. and international suppliers from whom we purchase the merchandise that we sell in our stores, clubs and online.

In the U.S., we utilize a network of 192 distribution facilities located strategically throughout the country using a combination of our private truck fleet as well as contracting with common carriers.
Outside the U.S., we utilize a total of 179 distribution facilities strategically located in Africa, Canada, Central America, Chile, China, India and Mexico.
Self-Healing Inventory: Detects imbalances in stock levels, then automatically redirects product to where it’s needed most — before issues show up in stores.
Walmart’s supply chain is vast, fast, and efficient. But it only works when suppliers pack, label, and ship their products according to the correct specifications.

caveats: The distribution-facility counts and fulfillment description are from Walmart's fiscal 2026 Form 10-K for the year ended 2026-01-31, so the physical network may have changed by 2026-11-11.
Walmart's technology article describes capabilities and examples across markets but does not provide a complete facility-by-facility map or quantify the share of volume handled by each technology.
Walmart's public description does not disclose a complete supplier roster, all carrier relationships, or end-to-end shipment volumes.
